messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: sudden spike in 5xxs and cross-region routing drift. apac-west2 5xx rate increased to 11.8% over last 5m; p50 latency for apac endpoints jumped from 120ms -> 520ms. Traffic steering shows ~28% of apac requests are being routed to eu-west2. Auto-severity: SEV-2. Notifying oncall.

Anita - oncall: Ack. I'm on it. @Li can you take netops lead? I'll start customer impact triage and open bridge.

Li (netops): Looking. Initial hypothesis: the latency-based steering heuristic flipped because of stale health check windows after the autoscaling event in apac-west2 at 01:38 UTC. Pulling steering logs now.

James L.: We had the adaptive-latency-steer rollout last night (canary -> 100%). Could be a regression where smoothing window is too short. If steering briefly sees eu-west2 as lower latency, it will yank traffic.

Sara M.: Customers on apac are reporting slow responses and some timeouts. Support queue shows 12 unique customer tickets flagged "apac slowness" since 01:45 UTC.

Li (netops): Quick checks:
```
# steeringctl query --region apac-west2 --metric latency --window 30s
region apac-west2: p50=520ms, p95=1.2s
region eu-west2: p50=180ms, p95=400ms
steer decision: prefer eu-west2 (score delta 0.32)
policy: adaptive-latency-steer v1.3
```
Looks like the algorithm is prioritizing p50 over tail latency, which is bad for this workload. Also seeing a health-check jitter on one apac backend (conn drops).

Anita - oncall: Options: (A) emergency disable adaptive steering (global -> fallback policy), (B) manual pin apac traffic to apac-west2 (short TTL), (C) scale up apac-backend until health stabilizes. Thoughts?

James L.: I vote A+B together: disable adaptive steer to stop flips, then manual pin while we pursue root cause. Disabling is quick: revert feature flag.

Li (netops): I'll do the disable and then apply a manual pin with 60s TTL. Executing now.

Li (netops): Executing commands:
```
# disable feature flag
featurectl set adaptive-latency-steer=false --env prod
# apply manual pin
steeringctl set-pin --region apac-west2 --ttl 60s --reason "mitigation: rolling back adaptive-steer"
```

IncidentBot: Action logged: featureflag adaptive-latency-steer=false (by Li). Steering pin applied to apac-west2 ttl=60s. Change IDs: FF-7682, PIN-4421.

Support Eng - Maya: Confirming with customer-facing teams: expedite messages to top impacted accounts. Drafting PSR (post-incident status report) note.

Anita - oncall: Monitoring metrics now. Li, keep pin refreshed until root cause fixed. Also create a canary group to validate if we re-enable later.

Li (netops): Metrics update 5m after mitigation: apac 5xx down to 2.0%, p50 back to 140ms. Traffic to eu-west2 from apac dropped to 3%. Looks stable.

Customer Ops - Rui: Escalation: major customer "CloudApps" impacted (3 repeated timeouts). CX team is on a call. We'll include them in the incident comms.

James L.: Next steps for root cause: 1) investigate autoscaler event around 01:38 and why it caused health-check jitter; 2) check if the latency steering heuristic was changed in v1.3 to weigh p50 heavily; 3) run replay tests against apac backend. I'll own 2).

Li (netops): Assigning 1) to me and SRE infra. Early look shows one host in apac-west2 had kernel OOM kills; kubelet restarted containers around that time. Could be a noisy neighbor or oomscore misconfig. Collecting node logs.

Anita - oncall: Good. I'll update status page to note partial degradation in APAC, mitigation in place, and ETA for next update 30m.

IncidentBot: Incident priority remains SEV-2. Bridge: https://call.bridge/redwood/incident-1769994321. Runbook link: /runbooks/geo-steering-failures.

Support Eng - Maya: Sent proactive messages to 5 highest-impact accounts, including CloudApps. They're asking for RCA and ETA; letting them know we're on mitigation and will follow up.

Li (netops): Node logs snippet:
```
Mar 12 01:37:48 node-az2 kubelet[1234]: eviction manager: pod "worker-7" OOMKilled
Mar 12 01:37:49 node-az2 systemd: docker: restart container worker-7
Mar 12 01:38:02 steering-agent[233]: health-check fail count ++ (host 10.2.5.7)
```
I filed a ticket for infra to check for noisy processes and to adjust oom_score_adj where appropriate.

James L.: I'll open a PR to change the steering heuristic test harness so p95/tail gets higher weight and add a cooldown to avoid flips during short autoscaler churn.

Anita - oncall: Handoff plan: I'll keep this until the next SRE shift (02:00 UTC). @Li please attach node diagnostics to the incident and put a summary in the incident doc. Whoever picks up afterwards, continue pin until we confirm safe re-enable.

IncidentBot: Update: last alert cleared for apac-west2 at 01:59:12 UTC. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

Customer Ops - Rui: CloudApps confirmed improved performance. They've asked for a follow-up RCA and timeline for a permanent fix.

Anita - oncall: Thanks team. Post-incident action items (brief):
- Li: node diag + infra ticket (INC-9872)
- James: steering heuristic PR + test (PR-4520)
- Maya: PSR & customer comms draft
- Anita: schedule RCA meeting and update runbook with cooldown suggestion

Anita - oncall: Handoff to SRE shift B at 02:00 UTC. Leaving pin TTL refresh every 50s until handoff confirmed.

Li (netops): Confirmed. I'll maintain pin refresh and attach diagnostics. Leaving logs in incident doc.

IncidentBot: Handoff recorded: Anita -> shift-B (02:00 UTC). Incident thread archived to incident-1769994321.

Anita - oncall: Closing live thread for now. We'll reconvene for RCA. :white_check_mark:
